analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($74.14) vs SMA5 ($73.79)/SMA20 ($71.92)/SMA50 ($75.67) — trading above short-term, below mid-term averages.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($84.52)/SMA200 ($90.13) — indicating a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (14.7%) — recovered from 52-week low but still far from 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 44.6 → 52.3 (exiting oversold) — attempting to break out of oversold territory.
· MACD histogram 0.6003 → 0.7073 (improving) — weak signal for trend reversal yet.
· Bollinger Band current price ($74.14) above mid-band ($71.92) — band width at 12.58%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($70.86) — close to Pivot S1 ($67.66) and SMA200 ($90.13).
· Swing resistance ($77.30) — adjacent to SMA50 ($75.67) and Pivot R1 ($78.03).
· 5-day high ($75.30)/low ($72.18), 20-day high ($75.45)/low ($65.08) — 5-day low > 20-day low → Higher Low pattern forming.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 0.72 — below 5-day average volume, indicating contraction.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — lacking clear direction, continuing sideways. Consider buy entry upon breaking $77.30, sell entry upon breaking $70.86.
